act_clause:

relation to the creation of a new office of cannabis management, as an

providing for the licensure of persons authorized to cultivate, process,

twenty-one or older; to amend the public health law, in relation to the
description of cannabis; to amend the penal law, in relation to the growing

general business law, the penal law and the criminal procedure law relating to
medical use of marihuana, in relation to the effectiveness thereof; to amend

office of cannabis management; to repeal certain provisions of the public
health law relating to growing of cannabis and medical use of marihuana; to
repeal article 221 of the penal law relating to offenses involving marihuana;
